system.description:
You spit several small nets of webbing from your mouth at up to 3 targets. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack against up to three targets you can see in range. On a hit, the affected creature has their movement speed reduced by 10 feet for each successful attack until the end of your next turn.

If a target is hit by 2 or more these attacks, they must make a Dexterity saving throw, having their hands bounds, being unable to cast jutsu that require Hand Signs (HS) until the end of your next turn.

If a target is hit by 3 of these attacks, on a failure of their Dexterity saving throw, they are also Blinded and Slowed until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of attacks you make by +1.
